items.utility_name: Lamar County Electric Cooperative Association (Lamar Electric Cooperative)

items.program_name: Residential Time-of-Use Rate (Pilot)
items.incentive_structure: rate discount/premium by period vs standard PSA
items.incentive_value_usd: on 8.442c/kWh, mid 4.118c/kWh, off 2.677c/kWh
items.event_limits: min 12-month term, back-billed if early exit, limited to 100 meters
items.on_peak_window: Weekdays on-peak 3-6pm, mid-peak 7am-3pm & 6-10pm; off-peak 10pm-7am; weekends all off-peak
items.export_compensation: Value-of-Solar Rider available separately
items.stackable_with: GreenChoice Rider; Community Solar Rider; Non-Demand Value-of-Solar Rider

items.program_name: EV360 Plug-In Electric Vehicle Charging Subscription
items.incentive_structure: subscription flat + TOU energy charge
items.incentive_value_usd: $30-50/mo demand charge + $150 enroll fee + $200 early term fee; on-peak 40c/kWh summer, 14c/kWh non-summer; off-peak $0
items.event_limits: Off-peak required for charging or on-peak penalty rate applies
items.on_peak_window: Weekdays on-peak 2-7pm; off-peak 7pm-2pm; weekends all off-peak
items.peak_offpeak_rates: summer on 40.0c/off 0c; non-summer on 14.0c/off 0c per kWh

items.program_name: Load Shifting Voltage Discount Rider
items.incentive_structure: on-peak demand/energy charge window with load-shift requirement
items.incentive_value_usd: demand & energy charges applied only during on-peak window; no separate $ premium published
items.event_limits: must shift >=30% of normal on-peak billed demand using storage tech (e.g. thermal/battery storage); no load forgiveness
items.on_peak_window: On-peak demand 3-6pm daily; on-peak energy 7am-10pm daily
items.peak_offpeak_rates: (rider narrows billing window, not a distinct rate)
items.export_compensation: cannot combine with Value-of-Solar Rider

items.program_name: Value-of-Solar Rider
items.incentive_structure: $/kWh bill credit for solar production (avoided cost + societal benefit)
items.incentive_value_usd: Non-Demand $0.0761/kWh avoided cost + $0.023/kWh societal benefit; Demand <1000kW-ac same; Demand >=1000kW-ac $0.0494/kWh avoided cost + $0.023/kWh societal benefit
items.event_limits: credit capped at total bill, excess rolls forward, forfeited at service termination
items.export_compensation: Non-Demand/Demand VoS credit ~9.9c/kWh (small) or ~7.2c/kWh (large) for on-site solar; not net metering
items.stackable_with: Cannot combine with Load Shifting Voltage Discount Rider; GreenChoice Rider

items.program_name: Solar Standard Offer Rider - Solar Integrator
items.incentive_structure: $/kWh export payment (buy-all-sell-all)
items.incentive_value_usd: <1MW-ac: $0.1124/kWh exported; >=1MW-ac: $0.0841/kWh exported
items.event_limits: paid quarterly, net of Secondary Voltage <10kW delivery charges
items.peak_offpeak_rates: export payment 11.24c/kWh (<1MW) or 8.41c/kWh (>=1MW), updated every 3 years starting March 2026
items.export_compensation: buy-all-sell-all export payment, separate from customer's own consumption billing

items.program_name: Power Partner Thermostat
items.incentive_structure: $/enrollment + annual bill credit + rebate
items.incentive_value_usd: $75 one-time enrollment incentive + $30/yr recurring bill credit + $50 thermostat rebate (2026 rates, up from $85/$25/$30)
items.event_limits: up to 40 events/yr; customer can override at any time

items.program_name: Power Partner Battery
items.incentive_structure: upfront rebate + $/kW-event performance payment
items.incentive_value_usd: recent install: $500 rebate (PTO on/after 2/18/25); performance: $75 per average kW delivered per event, ~$324/yr average per battery (avg reward ~$750 total)
items.event_limits: max 40 events/yr excl. grid emergencies; customer can override (5-min cutoff for Enphase); paid annually by check
items.export_compensation: exports excess to grid after backup reserve/home load served; subject to installer export limits

items.program_name: Residential Solar Rebate
items.incentive_structure: upfront $ rebate per qualifying system
items.incentive_value_usd: $4,000 flat rebate for eligible system-owned home solar (raised from $2,500 in July 2026)
items.event_limits: system-owned (not leased/PPA); must use participating solar contractor
items.export_compensation: paired with Value-of-Solar Rider for ongoing export payment

items.program_name: Commercial Demand Response (Standard DR / Fast DR / ADR)
items.incentive_structure: $/avg kW saved per event, tiered by window & speed
items.incentive_value_usd: Standard DR $50-70/avg kW; Fast DR $65-80/avg kW; Fast ADR w/ Year-1 bonus $265-280/avg kW; min annual payout $25, max $76,000/facility/yr
items.event_limits: max 25 events/yr (more if EEA emergency), up to 2 hrs each, Jun1-Sep30 1-7pm window (no events July 4/Labor Day)
items.on_peak_window: 1:00pm-7:00pm weekdays Jun-Sep (also 4-7pm and EEA emergencies 24/7/365 sub-tiers)
items.stackable_with: Cannot overlap with ERCOT ERS enrollment Jun-Sep

items.program_name: WiFi Thermostat Rewards
items.incentive_structure: $/enrollment + annual bill credit
items.incentive_value_usd: $85 one-time enrollment credit (per thermostat) + $30/yr recurring bill credit (paid Oct/Nov)
items.event_limits: conservation events typically 1-10pm weekdays Jun-Sep; customer can override at thermostat/app anytime

items.program_name: Commercial Demand Response
items.incentive_structure: $/kW capacity credit, tiered by notice time & duration
items.incentive_value_usd: 30-min notice/2hr max: $73/kW-summer; 2hr notice/2hr max: $70/kW; 1hr notice/1hr max (max 6 events): $31/kW; Jul-Aug 2hr program: $47/kW
items.event_limits: max 25 events/yr (or 18 for Jul-Aug option, 6 for 1-hr option); Jun1-Sep30, weekdays 1-7pm typical, ~3 hrs/event; multi-site aggregation allowed

items.program_name: Commercial & Industrial Energy Efficiency Incentives (HVAC/Lighting/Refrigeration)
items.incentive_structure: $/kW + $/kWh upfront rebate, up to 60-75% of project cost
items.incentive_value_usd: LED interior $325/kW + $0.05/kWh; LED exterior $250/kW + $0.05/kWh; HVAC chiller $525/kW + $0.05/kWh; HVAC DX/controls $350/kW + $0.05/kWh; building envelope/refrigeration $200/kW + $0.03/kWh; custom $200/kW + $0.05/kWh
items.event_limits: lighting incentives capped at 60% of project cost; non-lighting capped at 75%

items.program_name: General Service Peak Capacity Charge
items.incentive_structure: seasonal $/kWh surcharge above 600kWh threshold, tied to summer demand
items.incentive_value_usd: Summer (Jun-Sep) $0.02150/kWh for all kWh over 600; Non-Summer (Oct-May) $0.01087/kWh for all kWh over 600; billing demand in non-summer = greater of monthly demand or 80% of prior summer peak demand
items.event_limits: not a TOU rate; billed on energy above 600kWh threshold scaled by demand; discourages high summer peak demand carried into non-summer months
items.tariff_schedule: General Service Base Commercial Electric Rate

items.program_name: Fleet and Public Electric Vehicle Charging Rate
items.incentive_structure: monthly demand + energy charge for dedicated EV charging meter
items.incentive_value_usd: Customer $883.58/mo; Demand $13.10/kW; Energy $0.00000/kWh (kWh recovered via demand); plus PSA $0.04118/kWh + Community Benefit + Regulatory Charge $3.73/kW
items.event_limits: limited to 10 customers first-come first-served; requires >=90% of load attributable to EV charging, avg monthly demand >100kW over prior 6 months; 12-month minimum before switching off rate
items.tariff_schedule: Fleet and Public EV Charging Rate

items.program_name: Residential Load Management Standard Offer Program (RLMSOP) 2026
